about: small-combo swing jazz: a soft swung ride and snare on a jazz kit, an upright bass walking low, a grand piano comping 7th and 9th chords in the middle, a vibraphone carrying the melody on top; 100-160 BPM, warm, dry and dynamic, played softly
master: transparent and natural: a small room, light bus compression at most, full dynamics kept; nothing distorted, pumped or brightened
